To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
human presence in the high Cordoba Mountains of Argentina decreases bird species richness and diversity and reduces the relative density of insectivorous birds.

(a) bird species richness and diversity were reduced by human visitation in high mountain habitats in the Córdoba Mountains; (b) the relative density of insectivorous birds was reduced by human visitations; (c) the relative density and abundance of some species was negatively affected by human presence; (d) the negative responses were not consistent among species, and (e) these results suggest that human visitation may be having a negative effect on bird populations in high mountain habitats.
